Calvin Klein My Euphoria miniature is a 10ml eau de parfum for women that puts a sweet, fruity floral into a size made for your bag. Blackcurrant and a pinch of pink pepper come first, then orchid, rose and jasmine, before a soft gourmand base of vanilla, amber and woods.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper
  • Heart notes: Orchid, Rose, Jasmine
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Woods

How it wears

The fruit keeps the opening bright, while the vanilla and amber give it a warm, rounded finish that feels close and comfortable. It works for evenings out, dinners and cooler months, and the small bottle makes it easy to carry from work to plans in the evening. As an eau de parfum, it holds more fragrance oil than an eau de toilette.

Good to know

  • 10ml miniature spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • A floral gourmand for her, good as a stocking filler or to try the scent before a larger bottle
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: CK Eternity Aromatic Essence 10ml or the Calvin Klein women's miniature set

Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum comes here as a 10ml eau de parfum for men, with an aromatic, leathery and woody character. Grapefruit and hemp lift the opening, black pepper and geranium add spice and green warmth, and leather with vetiver gives a dark, dry base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Grapefruit, Hemp
  • Heart notes: Black Pepper, Geranium
  • Base notes: Leather, Vetiver

How it wears

It starts sharp and citrusy, then turns smoky and masculine as the pepper and leather come through. That deeper side suits evenings, autumn and winter, and smart occasions where you want something with a bit of edge. The compact size slips into a jacket pocket or wash bag, so it is a practical way to take the scent away for a weekend.

Good to know

  • 10ml travel spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • For him: aromatic, woody and leathery
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: the Bad Boy Le Parfum 150ml or 212 VIP Men

Inspired by the romance and mystery of Venice, Tiziana Terenzi Casanova Anniversary is a unisex extrait de parfum with a rich amber and woody heart. Powdery notes, fig leaf, orchid, bergamot and jasmine open it, before spices, leather and resin give way to a warm base of musk, amber and tonka bean.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Powdery Notes, Fig Leaf, Orchid, Bergamot, Jasmine
  • Heart notes: Ambergris, Myrrh, Leather, Cardamom, Guaiac Wood, Pink Pepper, Vanilla
  • Base notes: White Musk, Ambroxan, Cedar, Amber, Vetiver, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss

How it wears

The first impression is soft and powdery with a green touch of fig leaf. Cardamom, myrrh and leather then make it richer, and the oakmoss and cedar keep the sweet tonka from turning heavy. An extrait is the most concentrated form of perfume, so this is one for evenings, celebrations and the colder months rather than a quick everyday spray.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex, from Tiziana Terenzi
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy or Al Haramain Amber Musk

Tiziana Terenzi Chimaera Anniversary Extrait de Parfum is a unisex scent of spice, flowers and dark woods, made in a 100ml bottle. Black pepper, lemon and saffron meet leather at the start, a bouquet of iris, peony, magnolia and rose follows, and the base settles on oud, tobacco, caramel and vanilla.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Black Pepper, Lemon, Saffron, Leather
  • Heart notes: Iris, Peony, Magnolia, Rose
  • Base notes: Oud, Patchouli, Tobacco, Amber, Caramel, Vanilla, Benzoin

How it wears

Pepper and saffron give it a dry, spicy opening, and the flowers soften it before the sweet, smoky oud and tobacco take over. The caramel and benzoin make the drydown feel cosy rather than sharp. With the high concentration of an extrait, it is best kept for winter nights, formal dinners and occasions where a deep, distinctive perfume feels right.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex oud scent from Italian perfume house Tiziana Terenzi
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gold Rose Oudh or Dubhe Assoluto

Bright citrus over a warm, woody base: that is Tiziana Terenzi Draconis Extrait de Parfum, a unisex 100ml fragrance from the Italian house. Bergamot, lemon, grapefruit and neroli open it, geranium, jasmine, lavender and spices form the heart, and amber, musk, patchouli and vetiver close it.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit, Neroli
  • Heart notes: Geranium, Jasmine, Lavender, Spices
  • Base notes: Amber, Musk, Patchouli, Vetiver, Woods

How it wears

The citrus top makes it feel clean and lively, and the lavender and geranium give it an aromatic, slightly herbal middle. Underneath, amber and patchouli add depth so it never feels thin. It is one of the fresher extraits we carry, easy to wear in spring and summer, at the office or on a warm evening out.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex: fresh citrus and aromatic with a woody amber base
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Sea Stars Deriva or Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura

Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Assoluto Extrait de Parfum is a deep, woody unisex perfume built on oud, rose and saffron. Cypriol, rose absolute and saffron lead, a layered heart of balsam, cedarwood, cassis, vanilla bean, white oud and orris follows, and amber, red patchouli, sandalwood and oud make up the base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cypriol, Rose Absolute, Saffron, Geranium
  • Heart notes: Gurjan Balsam, Cedarwood, Cassis, Vanilla Bean, White Oud, Orris, Guaiac Wood
  • Base notes: Amber, Red Patchouli, Musk, Sandalwood, Oud

How it wears

Rose and saffron give a warm, spiced opening with an earthy edge from the cypriol. As it settles, the woods and balsam take the lead, with a little fruit from the cassis and creaminess from the vanilla and sandalwood. This is a rich, oriental-style extrait for cold weather, evenings and special occasions, and it suits anyone who loves oud and rose together.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex, with an Italian niche character
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gold Rose Oudh

Smoke, resin and pine set Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy Extrait de Parfum apart, a bold unisex scent with woody, spicy and aromatic accords. Pine, spruce and a mineral stone powder note open it, incense, patchouli and rose sit at the heart, and sandalwood, amber, tonka bean, labdanum and musk round it off.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pine, Spruce, Stone Powder
  • Heart notes: Incense, Patchouli, Rose
  • Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Tonka Bean, Labdanum, Musk

How it wears

The forest notes give a cool, resinous start, almost like a walk through woods in winter. Incense then brings the smoky character, softened by a touch of rose, before the amber and labdanum warm everything up. It feels at home on cold days, at evening events and in quieter moments when you want a perfume with real depth.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex, from the Italian house Tiziana Terenzi
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Tiziana Terenzi Casanova Anniversary

Elie Saab La Collection des Essences No. 1 Rose is a unisex eau de parfum that puts rose at the centre. Fresh rose facets lead into soft floral accords, and the scent rests on a base of amber, woods and musk for a smooth, rounded finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Key note: Rose
  • Heart notes: Floral Accords
  • Base notes: Amber, Woods, Musk

How it wears

This is a rose that stays elegant rather than sweet, with the woods and amber giving it a little warmth and the musk keeping it soft. Because it is built around one flower, it is easy to wear and easy to share, whether you prefer a feminine or a more neutral scent. It suits daytime, the office and spring weddings, and the warm base carries it into the evening too.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex, part of Elie Saab La Collection des Essences
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Boucheron Rose d'Isparta

Elie Saab La Collection des Essences No. 4 Oud is a unisex eau de parfum built around deep oud and warm woody accords. Spices and woods form its heart, and amber, resins and musk give it a smooth, resinous base.

Fragrance notes

  • Key note: Oud
  • Heart notes: Woody Accords, Spices
  • Base notes: Amber, Resins, Musk

How it wears

It is a rich, refined oud rather than a smoky or animalic one: the spices bring warmth, the resins add a slightly sweet depth and the musk keeps the finish soft. That makes it a good first oud for anyone new to the note, as well as a dependable choice for those who already love it. Wear it in autumn and winter, to evening dinners or whenever you want a warm, grown-up scent.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex, part of Elie Saab La Collection des Essences
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Al Haramain Amber Oud Black Edition

anatomē Energy Eau de Parfum in a 10ml travel spray is a bright, unisex citrus-and-blossom scent from the anatomē eau de parfum range. It takes its cue from sport and movement, with a clean, lively character that feels at home on the court or in the city.

Expect fresh citrus lifted by soft blossom, light and airy rather than sweet or heavy.

How it wears

Energy is crisp and open, the kind of fragrance you reach for in the morning, after a shower or before heading out for a busy day on your feet. It suits warm weather, weekends outdoors and casual daytime plans, and it is easy for anyone to wear. The travel size fits a gym bag or a pocket, so you can keep it with you while you are out and about.

Good to know

  • 10ml travel spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex, from the anatomē eau de parfum range
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: anatomē Energy 100ml or Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Discovery Set

Etienne Aigner First Class Explorer is a men's eau de toilette with a fresh, aromatic start and a warm woody finish. Citrus and aromatic herbs open it brightly, spices and woods give it shape, and amber with musk smooths out the drydown. It is an easy, confident scent for everyday wear.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Citrus, aromatic herbs
  • Heart notes: Spices, woody accords
  • Base notes: Amber, musk, woods

How it wears

The herbal citrus opening feels clean and lively, which makes it a natural pick for the office, weekends and warmer days. As the spices and woods come through, it turns calmer and a little richer, so it also works for a relaxed dinner on a cooler evening. As an eau de toilette it sits on the lighter side, a good fit if you prefer a fragrance that stays close and polished rather than heavy.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Woody aromatic fragrance for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Al Haramain L'Aventure or Antonio Banderas Diavolo

The anatomē Expression Eau de Parfum 10ml is a unisex scent inspired by waterfalls and coastal landscapes, made for quieter moments in a busy day. It comes in a slim 10ml glass travel atomiser that slips easily into a wash bag or carry-on.

How it wears

Its theme of falling water and the coast gives it an open, airy feel that suits slow mornings, a walk outdoors or a quiet pause between meetings. The travel size makes it simple to keep with you for a quick spritz on the go, whether you are at your desk or travelling. Because it is unisex, it is an easy choice to share or to give.

The anatomē eau de parfum range is built around choosing a scent to match the moment, and Expression sits alongside other travel-size parfums in the same collection, so you can keep two or three on rotation. An eau de parfum has a higher concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette, which gives a fuller scent from a small bottle.

Good to know

  • 10ml glass travel atomiser
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: anatomē Balance Travel 10ml or anatomē Order Travel 10ml

anatomē Focus Eau de Parfum is a spicy, warm unisex scent that opens with cardamom and black pepper. Earthy nagarmotha and ylang ylang form the middle, and a base of patchouli, benzoin, tonka and sandalwood gives it a warm, rounded finish. It comes as a 10ml travel spray.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cardamom, elemi, black pepper, green pepper, petitgrain
  • Heart notes: Nagarmotha, ylang ylang, nutmeg
  • Base notes: Patchouli, opoponax, benzoin, tonka, sandalwood

How it wears

The peppery, green opening is crisp and bright, so it feels at home at a desk, in a meeting or on a morning commute. Once the spice settles, the resins and sandalwood bring a soft warmth that carries it into the evening, especially in autumn and winter. The ylang ylang adds a light floral edge without turning it sweet, which keeps it easy to wear for anyone.

Good to know

  • 10ml travel spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex, spicy woody character
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: anatomē Balance 100ml

Jo Milano Game of Spades Emerald Unisex EDP 100ml is an eau de parfum from the Jo Milano Paris Game of Spades collection. It balances freshness with depth, so it sits comfortably on men and women alike.

How it wears

With a fresh side and a deeper core, Emerald is a versatile choice rather than a scent for one moment. It works for the working week and for evenings out, and its unisex character makes it easy to share with a partner. In warmer months the fresher side tends to stand out, while on cooler days the deeper side comes forward.

As an eau de parfum it carries a higher concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette. The full-size 100ml bottle also makes it a thoughtful gift for someone who enjoys trying a scent from a house they may not know yet, or for anyone building a small collection of everyday fragrances.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex, from the Jo Milano Paris Game of Spades collection
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Game of Spades Rouge

Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh is a unisex Italian extrait de parfum where Bulgarian rose meets oud, amber and honey. Bergamot, fir and a smoky touch of embers and sand open it, black pepper and patchouli frame the rose, and the base settles into oud, sandalwood, musk and honey. Woody, floral and warm, it has plenty of character.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, fir, embers, sand
  • Heart notes: Bulgarian rose, patchouli, black pepper
  • Base notes: Oud, amber, sandalwood, musk, honey

How it wears

This is a rich, resinous rose that feels best on cool evenings, at dinners and on special occasions. The honey and amber lend a soft sweetness to the darker oud and patchouli, so it reads warm rather than sharp. An extrait de parfum has a high concentration of fragrance oils.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Extrait de parfum
  • Unisex rose and oud fragrance
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Tiziana Terenzi Dubhe Assoluto

Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette in a 10ml miniature is a lighter, brighter version of the Bloom scent for women. Neroli, bergamot and mandarin give it a sunny citrus start, jasmine, tuberose and Rangoon creeper form a white floral heart, and soft musk with sandalwood finishes it gently.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Neroli, bergamot, mandarin
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, tuberose, Rangoon creeper
  • Base notes: Musk, sandalwood

How it wears

Fresh and graceful, it suits daytime: the office, lunch with friends, spring and summer days. The citrus keeps the white flowers airy, so it never feels heavy, and the musky base leaves a clean, soft trail. An eau de toilette is lighter than an eau de parfum, which makes this a relaxed everyday floral.

The small bottle is handy for a handbag or travel, and a simple way to try Bloom before a larger size.

Good to know

  • 10ml miniature spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Floral fragrance for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gucci Bloom Profumo di Fiori pen spray or Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml

Gucci Bloom Parfum in a 10ml miniature is the richest take on Bloom, a warm floral for women in a pocket-sized spray. Apricot, cardamom and coral jasmine open it with a soft fruity spice, the heart is full of tuberose, jasmine sambac and Rangoon creeper, and vanilla, a sweet moss accord and Peru balsam give it a creamy, balsamic base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Apricot, cardamom, coral jasmine
  • Heart notes: Tuberose, jasmine sambac, Rangoon creeper
  • Base notes: Vanilla, sweet moss accord, Peru balsam

How it wears

Where the lighter Bloom versions feel airy, this parfum is deeper and more enveloping, with the vanilla and balsam showing through the white flowers. It is lovely for evenings, autumn and winter, date nights and celebrations. Parfum is the most concentrated form of a fragrance.

Good to know

  • 10ml miniature spray
  • Parfum
  • Floral fragrance for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gucci Bloom eau de parfum gift set or Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia

Gucci Bloom Profumo di Fiori Eau de Parfum comes in a 10ml pen spray, a slim way to carry this radiant floral for women. It is built on an intense bouquet of jasmine sambac, Rangoon creeper, tuberose and ylang-ylang, with sandalwood, benzoin, orris and musk underneath for a warm, soft finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Jasmine sambac, Rangoon creeper
  • Heart notes: Tuberose, ylang-ylang, jasmine
  • Base notes: Sandalwood, benzoin, orris, musk

How it wears

Profumo di Fiori leans fully into the flowers: lush, creamy and generous from the first spray. The ylang-ylang adds a golden richness, and the powdery orris and soft woods make the base feel smooth. It suits evenings, weddings and summer nights, and makes a warm signature for cooler days too.

The pen spray fits in a clutch or a jacket pocket, so it is easy to take along when travelling or heading out after work.

Good to know

  • 10ml pen spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Floral fragrance for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml or Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 10ml

The Gucci Flora Gorgeous Miniature Perfume Set brings together three 5ml fragrances from the Flora Gorgeous collection: Gorgeous Gardenia, Gorgeous Magnolia and Gorgeous Orchid. Between them they cover fruity, floral, woody and gourmand styles, so it is an easy way to discover the line or to find your favourite.

Fragrance notes

  • Gorgeous Gardenia: Pear blossom, white gardenia, jasmine, brown sugar
  • Gorgeous Magnolia: Dewberries, coconut, magnolia, jasmine sambac, patchouli, blond woods
  • Gorgeous Orchid: Vanilla duo, vanilla orchid, ozonic accord

How it wears

Gardenia is sweet and sunny with its pear blossom and brown sugar, a cheerful daytime floral. Magnolia is fruitier, with dewberries and coconut over a soft woody base that works from day into evening. Orchid is the creamiest of the three, a vanilla floral with an airy edge for cosy evenings. Three small bottles make it simple to switch with the occasion or the season.

Good to know

  • Set of three 5ml bottles: Gorgeous Gardenia, Gorgeous Magnolia and Gorgeous Orchid
  • A good size for travel or gifting
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum in a 10ml miniature is a creamy floral gourmand for women. A vanilla duo leads into vanilla orchid, and an ozonic accord keeps the sweetness light and airy, giving it a modern, luminous feel.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Vanilla duo
  • Heart notes: Vanilla orchid
  • Key accord: Ozonic accord

How it wears

Soft and sweet without feeling heavy, Orchid is a comforting scent for cosy evenings, winter weekends and nights out. The ozonic accord adds a fresh, airy lift to the vanilla, so it also feels pleasant on milder days. As an eau de parfum it has a fuller concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette, giving the vanilla a smooth, rounded presence.

The miniature is ideal for travel and for anyone who wants to get to know Orchid before choosing a bigger bottle.

Good to know

  • 10ml miniature spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Floral gourmand fragrance for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml

Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum in a 10ml miniature is a warm floral amber scent for women. Mandora and bergamot open it brightly, lilac and rose follow, and patchouli with amber notes gives it a soft, deeper finish. The small spray makes it easy to carry in a handbag or try before a larger bottle.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mandora, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
  • Heart notes: Lilac, Rose, Violet, Geranium
  • Base notes: Patchouli, Amber Notes

How it wears

A touch of pink pepper keeps the citrus opening lively, while the lilac and violet heart gives it a powdery, feminine middle. The patchouli and amber base suits evenings out and cooler months, yet a light spray works for daytime too. Geranium adds a faintly green note that keeps the florals from turning too sweet.

Good to know

  • 10ml miniature spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml or Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 10ml

Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Ma Robe Cocktail is a light, playful eau de toilette for women, built on sparkling citrus, red fruit and soft flowers. Bergamot, lemon and orange open with red berries, cherry joins rose and jasmine at the heart, and white amber with musk rounds it off. It is a chic choice for everyday wear.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Orange, Red Berries
  • Heart notes: Rose, Jasmine, Cherry
  • Base notes: White Amber, Musk, Patchouli

How it wears

As an eau de toilette it is lighter in concentration than an eau de parfum, which suits its bright, fruity character. The citrus and berry start feels fresh on a spring morning, and the cherry and rose heart keeps it cheerful for the office, lunches and weekends. A touch of patchouli under the musk stops it from feeling too sweet.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together or the Mon Guerlain miniature set

Guerlain L’Instant de Guerlain Eau de Parfum 75ml is a warm, honeyed floral for women, with a citrus opening and a smooth vanilla and amber base. Mandarin orange, bergamot and red apple lead into magnolia, jasmine, ylang-ylang and iris, before honey, benzoin and musk settle on the skin. It makes an elegant signature scent.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Red Apple
  • Heart notes: Magnolia, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Iris
  • Base notes: Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin, Musk

How it wears

The fruit at the top is brief and fresh; the character comes from the creamy magnolia and the powdery touch of iris. Honey and benzoin give the dry-down a golden warmth that feels right for dinners, celebrations and autumn and winter days. Its soft balance also suits anyone who wants one refined fragrance for most occasions.

Good to know

  • 75ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Guerlain Samsara or the Mon Guerlain miniature set

Hemel Amethyst Dream is a fruity floral eau de parfum for anyone, opening with a juicy mix of mandarin orange, grapefruit, peach and a sweet hint of toffee. Damask rose and violet bloom in the heart with earthy patchouli, and the base is a soft blend of musk and moss.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Peach, Toffee
  • Heart notes: Damask Rose, Patchouli, Violet
  • Base notes: Musk, Moss

How it wears

This is the most playful of the Hemel scents we stock: the peach and toffee give the first minutes a dessert-like sweetness, kept bright by grapefruit. Once the rose and violet come through, it turns more romantic, and the mossy musk keeps the finish clean rather than heavy. Wear it on sunny afternoons, weekends and parties, or whenever you want something cheerful.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Hemel Rosado or Hemel Fragrance Affair

Hemel Gris Eau de Parfum is a unisex citrus woody scent that starts sharp and peppery, then turns smooth and polished. Pink pepper, lemon and bergamot give it a crisp opening, rose and jasmine sit alongside sandalwood and patchouli, and oakmoss, vanilla, amber and musk form a deep base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pink Pepper, Lemon, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Rose, Jasmine, Sandalwood, Patchouli
  • Base notes: Oakmoss, Vanilla, Amber, Musk

How it wears

Gris is the grown-up, tailored one of the Hemel range, quiet in character and neat in shape. The lemon and pepper feel clean and businesslike for the office, while the oakmoss and sandalwood give it a dry, woody depth that works well in cooler weather. The florals stay in the background, so it suits men and women equally.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Hemel Patchouli For All or Boucheron Patchouli d’Angkor

Hemel Plateado is a spicy woody eau de parfum for men and women, with a bright citrus start and a smoky, sweet finish. Mandarin, bergamot and pepper open it, lavender and cinnamon leaf meet cedar in the heart, and tobacco, tonka bean, amber, musk and vanilla make up a rich base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mandarin, Pepper, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Cedar, Lavender, Cinnamon Leaf
  • Base notes: Amber, Musk, Tonka Bean, Tobacco, Vanilla

How it wears

Of the Hemel scents, Plateado is the boldest and warmest. The lavender and cinnamon give it an aromatic, almost barbershop feel, and the tobacco and tonka bring a dark sweetness as it settles. It is at its best on autumn and winter evenings, at dinners and on nights out. Bergamot and mandarin keep the first spray lively before the spice takes over.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Boucheron Patchouli d’Angkor or Hemel Gris

Hemel Rosado Eau de Parfum is a soft floral amber for anyone who likes rose with a warm, gentle base. Bergamot, pink pepper and fruity notes lift the opening, rose, jasmine and violet form the heart, and amber, musk, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth, modern finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Fruity Notes
  • Heart notes: Rose, Jasmine, Violet
  • Base notes: Amber, Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla

How it wears

Where some rose scents feel formal, Rosado is relaxed and easy, with the flowers wrapped in creamy sandalwood and vanilla. It moves well from day to evening, so it is a good pick for workdays that end with plans. The pink pepper adds just enough spark to keep it from feeling powdery, and the fruity notes give the first few minutes a light, juicy lift.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Unisex
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Hemel Amethyst Dream or Hemel Valley of Diamond

Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum comes here as a 4.5ml miniature: a rich floral gourmand for women. Rose and bitter almond open it, cherry, jasmine and vetiver make up the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber and oakmoss give a warm finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Rose, Bitter Almond
  • Heart notes: Cherry, Jasmine, Vetiver
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Oakmoss

How it wears

The almond and cherry give it a sweet, marzipan-like edge, while vetiver and oakmoss add a green, earthy thread so it never turns sugary. It feels made for evenings, date nights and the colder months. The tiny bottle is handy for travel, for a gift, or for trying the scent before committing to a full size, and it slips easily into a pocket or clutch.

Good to know

  • 4.5ml miniature
